run_release_patch: run the release utils script with --release-type patch to bump the patch version
run_release_minor: run the release utils script with --release-type minor to bump the minor version
run_release_major: run the release utils script with --release-type major to bump the major version
run_release_update_version: run the release utils script with --update-version to write the new version to version.py
get_next_version: call get_next_version with a release type to compute the next version tuple and tag string
